title: US Divorce Fell From 4.7 To 2.4
hook: US divorce fell to 2.4 per thousand.
closing: Later marriages arrived alongside fewer divorces.
question: What marriage age feels right?

segments.say: US divorce reached 2.4 per thousand, nearly half its 1990 rate.
Women's first-marriage age reached 28.6, almost five years later than in 1990.
